Python 3.15 shipped, and Meta detailed OCP open networking and Media over QUIC deployment. China items include Foreign Ministry statements, a mineral resources catalog, and the first Bryde's whale habitat. Science and opinion pieces remain largely research claims or author views.

subsections.briefing_summary: 研究发布 GeopoliticalQA 基准，针对地缘政治与战略情报报告异构、分析复杂的特点，评测检索增强问答中的检索与生成能力。GeoFitBench-LLM 基准评估大模型在地理分析任务中获取地理空间数据需求的能力，弥补现有评测忽视该环节的不足。立场论文《没有锚点的忠实性》指出，可解释 AI 工具本意是提升对模型的信任，但十年证据显示该目标总体失败，并分析特征重要性忠实性指标的结构性错位。VEPA 为访问私有文档、可变系统状态等敏感资源的 LLM 智能体提供运行时可检查、可复现、确定性的允许或拒绝决策护栏。无监督多模态奖励建模则无需人工偏好标注：在冻结的 Qwen3-VL 主干中间层加线性头，训练其给网络标题打出高于扰动文本的分数。
subsections.briefing_title_en: Research and Governance: Intelligence QA and Geospatial-Requirements Benchmarks, Doubts on XAI Faithfulness, Agent Guardrails, and Unsupervised Reward Modeling
subsections.briefing_summary_en: The GeopoliticalQA benchmark targets retrieval-augmented QA over heterogeneous, analytically complex geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports, evaluating retrieval and generation. GeoFitBench-LLM assesses large language models' ability to elicit geospatial data requirements for geo-analytic tasks, an aspect largely missing from current evaluations. The position paper "Faithfulness Without Anchors" argues explainable AI tools intended to increase trust in models have largely failed on that goal over a decade of evidence, and analyzes structural misalignments in faithfulness metrics for feature-importance explanations. VEPA provides runtime, inspectable, reproducible, deterministic allow-or-refuse guardrails for LLM agents operating over sensitive resources such as private documents and mutable system states. Unsupervised multimodal reward modeling needs no human preference labels: a linear head on an intermediate layer of a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone is trained to score a web caption above a perturbed caption.

sections.briefing_title_en: World Affairs Briefing: War Shrinks Middle East Economies as Ukraine and Israel Tensions Persist
sections.briefing_summary_en: The IMF warns that the Middle East and Central Asia economy will shrink in 2026 due to the US-Israel war on Iran, with Iraq, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar facing double-digit GDP declines. Ukraine's former top general Syrskyi says Russia's offensive ability is broken, while Zelensky says six Ukrainian energy sites have been hit by Russia since Trump announced a ceasefire. A Saudi minister vows a serious response to Houthi attacks on Riyadh's airport that killed 13 people, and the Tigray conflict puts the UAE and Saudi Arabia's positions under scrutiny. Ahead of Israel's October 27 election, Trump has not endorsed Netanyahu; the EU confirms it will cap Chinese hybrid vehicle imports at 350,000 a year; and Bolivia investigates former president Evo Morales over alleged ties to 2009 killings. Meanwhile, Hurricane Simon and Tropical Storm Rachel kill at least five on Mexico's Pacific coast, islanders say data centres are taking their water, and Argentina temporarily closes Iguazu Falls after an El Niño-fuelled surge in water levels.
